title: Tanvi Sharma Advances to Korea Open Round of 16
indian_angle: Young Indian shuttler Tanvi Sharma continues her impressive run, securing a spot in the pre-quarterfinals of a major international tournament.
summary: Tanvi Sharma defeated Japan's Manami Suizu at the Korea Open 2026 and will now face Hina Akechi in the Round of 16, marking their fourth encounter.

title: PV Sindhu Qualifies for BWF World Tour Finals 2026
indian_angle: India's star shuttler PV Sindhu has secured her place in the prestigious BWF World Tour Finals, marking her return to the elite event after a five-year hiatus.
summary: PV Sindhu has successfully qualified for the BWF World Tour Finals 2026 in Hangzhou, making her first appearance at the season-ending tournament since 2021.

title: Lakshya Sen on Smart Training and Workload After Hylo Open Win
indian_angle: India's top male singles player Lakshya Sen shares insights into his injury management and training strategy following his recent BWF Super 500 Hylo Open victory.
summary: Following his BWF Super 500 HYLO Open title win, Lakshya Sen spoke about his efforts to manage injuries and workload through smart training, aiming to play freely and give his best.

title: Badminton Fund Row Leaves Players to Fend for Themselves
indian_angle: An administrative dispute between SAI and BAI has reportedly led to Indian players, including top stars like PV Sindhu and Lakshya Sen, having to cover their own expenses due to delayed fund clearances.
summary: A funding dispute between the Sports Authority of India (SAI) and the Badminton Association of India (BAI) has left Indian badminton players, including PV Sindhu and Lakshya Sen, to manage their own expenses due to delays in fund disbursement.

title: BAI Forms New Athletes Committee for Player Representation
indian_angle: The Badminton Association of India has officially formed an Athletes Committee, aiming to provide a structured platform for player representation and input in administrative decisions.
summary: The Badminton Association of India (BAI) announced the formation of its new Athletes Committee on October 2, 2026, to ensure better representation and engagement of players in the sport's governance.
